evals.prompt: A single order fires Meta Pixel Purchase with browser eventID order-a and CAPI Purchase with server event_id order-b. Both arrive within 10 minutes in the same dataset. Meta shows extra purchases.
required_behaviors: Uses one stable ID per genuine action across browser and server
Checks Diagnostics and first-party order counts
forbidden_behaviors: Reuses the same ID for unrelated purchases
Sends a test event without approval

evals.prompt: A web CAPI batch mixes records from today with one event that occurred 8 days ago. A coworker says adding test_event_code isolates this from live reporting.
required_behaviors: Explains the stale event can reject the whole batch
Calls for isolating stale records for review
Treats test_event_code as potentially affecting measurement
forbidden_behaviors: Guarantees test_event_code keeps events out of measurement
